current_assessment.assessment: Independence of a standard from whichever verdict is produced does not establish an ontically external standard. A positive intrinsic proposal treats one productive actuality as essentially recipient-perfecting, with genuine rational fulfillment and jointly required relations, rather than making whatever occurs good. Local due perfection alone does not supply original productive finality: the actual exercise must manifest that positive nature. The external-standard objection succeeds conditionally with an independent standard, a real constitutive or explanatory dependence, and an inclusive source-sufficiency claim excluding it; that dependence has not been established for the strongest intrinsic rival. A personal constitution has a distinctive account of apprehended practical specification, but cognition alone neither makes the object good nor proves its actual guidance. The executed pair-count correction excludes output-indexed correctness and leaves both stronger constitutions available for further assessment. No full ultimate realization, global explanatory equivalence, strongest-rival defeat or premise discharge is claimed. The due/unrestricted bridge retains AllActualitiesDue; ActualRoot retains its actual-concrete relation-relative scope.
